source: Matterport model D9CVkjeMoQx: address, geolocation, description 'Unit #205' (samples/matterport_model_D9CVkjeMoQx.json)
north_offset_note: Added to every wall azimuth. R10 takes compass north from the Matterport Model API (source 'processing') and says it could be wrong by 90 or 180 degrees. Correct it here, in one place.

facade_point.source: North-east corner of the Vexcel footprint (first vertex of footprint.wkt in samples/vexcel_property_extract_2125_yale.json). R5 and R10 place the unit at the block's north-east corner; the Matterport point itself is offset by more than 10 m (R10 Conflicts). Used as the receiver for every exterior wall.

era.source: docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md section 5: year built unknown (CoStar not reachable, R5); use the 2000 onward defaults

storeys_source: Vexcel structure-extract roof height 14.54 m / 3.0 m storey height (assumptions rooms.storey_height), rounded; R5
unit_floor_source: Unit number 205 in the Matterport description, read as second floor. Not measured. Means: not the top floor (no roof exposure) and the 2000-onward upper-floor wall type applies.
geometry_source: Rooms: Matterport Model API (R5). Exterior walls, openings and partitions: R10 (samples/R10_yale_exterior_walls.csv, samples/R10_yale_partitions.csv), measured from the MatterPak mesh at 1 cm per pixel, openings +/- 5 cm.
